entries.title: Introduction
entries.text: I'm Avrodeep Pal, an AI Systems Engineer based in Barrackpore, near Kolkata. I work as an SDE at GenAIus Technology on backend infrastructure for an AI platform: RAG pipelines, agent workflows, model serving and security hardening. MCA from Jadavpur University, B.Sc. Computer Science from Barrackpore Rastraguru Surendranath College where I ranked 1st across WBSU. My interest sits where backend engineering meets applied ML, with cybersecurity running through both.

entries.title: What I'm doing now
entries.text: As of September 2026: working at GenAIus on backend infrastructure and multimodal model integration, running an independent research project on reasoning models, and preparing for GATE 2028 as my main target. I'm not open to other work opportunities right now and I don't do freelance. My focus is my current role and the research path.

entries.title: My research side project
entries.text: I'm measuring whether reinforcement learning post-training makes test-time search less useful in small language models. If RL sharpens what a model could already find rather than teaching it something new, then best-of-N and tree search should buy less on top of an RL-tuned model than on the base one. Running on free Kaggle dual-T4 GPUs, using procedurally generated puzzles so the task stays contamination-free.

entries.title: GATE and higher studies
entries.text: GATE 2028 is my main target. I sat it in 2024 and 2025 as practice without serious preparation and skipped 2026 to gain industry experience, which was the right call. The goal afterwards is an MS(Research) or research assistant position at an Indian AI lab working on reasoning models, rather than a standard M.Tech. The research route matters more to me than the degree name.
aliases: does he want to do a phd

entries.title: Where I want to go
entries.text: My research interest is reasoning in language models, specifically the trade-off between training-time and inference-time compute. I'm also drawn to bringing verifiable-reward RL into security, where I have production experience and where you can actually check whether a model's reasoning was right, because you know which line was vulnerable. Most reasoning research has a ground-truth problem; security doesn't.

entries.title: MCA at Jadavpur University
entries.text: Master of Computer Applications at Jadavpur University, Kolkata, October 2024 to July 2026, under the CSE department. Graduated First Class with CGPA 8.90 out of 10. Alongside coursework I was Placement Coordinator for the batch, presented a seminar on reasoning models, and did my thesis on cross-lingual Bengali idiom matching under Prof. Diganta Saha.

entries.title: B.Sc. Computer Science (Hons.)
entries.text: B.Sc. Computer Science (Honours) at Barrackpore Rastraguru Surendranath College, under West Bengal State University, October 2021 to August 2024. CGPA 9.91 out of 10 and 1st rank in Computer Science across WBSU. The syllabus gave me the foundations I still lean on: operating systems, networks, DBMS, data structures.

entries.title: WB-JECA 2024 rank
entries.text: Ranked 2nd in WB-JECA 2024 with 101.75 out of 120. It's the state-level entrance exam for MCA admission across West Bengal, covering OOP, data structures, algorithms, operating systems, networking, DBMS and machine learning.

entries.title: Schooling
entries.text: St. Augustine's Day School, Barrackpore. 91.80% in ICSE (Class 10), then Science with PCMCs — Physics, Chemistry, Maths, Computer Science — and 95.75% in ISC (Class 12). An English-medium ICSE and ISC background is also why I'm comfortable presenting and explaining things on the spot.

entries.title: Placement Coordinator, MCA Jadavpur
entries.text: One of three placement coordinators for the JU MCA 2024-26 batch, with Chitranku Sarkar and Pratik Kotal. The role was mostly documentation and communication: coordinating with recruiters, managing drive logistics, keeping the batch informed, and leaving a roadmap for the juniors. It's also where Let's Connect came from — I built it to fix our own outreach problem.

entries.title: How I work
entries.text: My best hours are 11 PM to 3 AM, with black tea and anime soundtracks. I work on Linux. My instinct on a new problem is to build the measurement rig before the thing itself — most of my projects are evaluation harnesses wearing a project's clothes. I'd rather ship an honest negative result than a flattering one I can't defend, and I document anything that broke in an interesting way.

entries.title: Choices I've made and why
entries.text: I chose MCA over an M.Sc. for employability and engineering-faculty exposure. When two offers landed I took the remote startup role over a larger company's information-security position that needed relocation about 2000 km from home — partly family proximity, partly because a small team means touching the whole stack, which is what happened. GATE 2024 and 2025 were practice; 2026 I skipped deliberately for industry experience.

entries.title: Languages I speak
entries.text: English, Bengali and Hindi. English is my working language and I think in it — an ICSE and ISC background means I'm fluent enough to take up oratory and explain things simply on the spot, even in unfamiliar territory. Bengali is my mother tongue. My MCA thesis was on Bengali idioms, partly out of curiosity about whether the idioms I grew up with land the same way in a model.

entries.title: Location and getting in touch
entries.text: Based in Barrackpore, North 24 Parganas, in the Kolkata metropolitan area. I work remotely and commute into Kolkata when needed. The best way to reach me is the Contact Me section on this site or LinkedIn at linkedin.com/in/AvrodeepPal. Good things to write about: reasoning models, LLM infrastructure, applied security, or DSA tips if you have good ones.
